title: Vignette

musical.notes: One cello, close enough to hear the player breathing — the audio equivalent of the dossier's first-person voice. -9 dB so it sits under the stage cue instead of fighting it.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental bed, 56 BPM, D minor. One cello, close-miked, breathing and unhurried, with faint room tone around it. Nothing else at all. Extremely sparse — long notes, wide gaps, no vibrato display, no melody to follow. Sits underneath without competing for attention. Loops seamlessly.
provenance.excludes: piano, strings section, drums, vocals, melody, swell, ambient pad, reverb wash

notes: Fades in under the stage cue when a first-person vignette has just appeared, and out again when the moment passes. The -9 dB trim is baked in at encode time by the pipeline, so the player sets one volume.
